courses.title: Healing with Archangel Raphael
courses.description: A recorded event with a twenty-minute guided journey to Archangel Raphael's Emerald Healing Temple and a forty-five-minute healing session, aimed at releasing old beliefs and emotional pain to make room for the new.

courses.title: Nervous System Reset
courses.description: A one-hour activation and meditation, as video and downloadable audio, working with crystalline light to settle the body and energy field during intense times and to receive guidance from your future self.

courses.title: Angelic First Aid
courses.description: A nine-minute angelic meditation with Archangels Michael, Raphael, Metatron and Sandalphon to clear, balance and ground your energy when you feel overwhelmed, or as a short daily practice.
